overview.description: Server Planner is a free, open-source planner for home labs: devices, racks and rooms, networks and firewalls, VMs, containers and apps, with capacity checks and traffic simulation. It runs entirely in your browser.
overview.privacyValue: No accounts, no telemetry, no cookies. Projects stay in this browser unless you export them.
